title: cerasus hortensis var. cordiformis
intro: Cerasus hortensis var. cordiformis, commonly known as dwarf cherry or sweet cherry, is a variety of cherry plant with heart-shaped leaves. The dwarf cherry is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive function. The therapeutic actions of the dwarf cherry include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the dwarf cherry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
